purpose: Judge whether RedCap is product-architecturally ready to enter formal public npm/CLI release readiness. This is stricter than npm pack safety: it asks whether RedCap is a safe, independent, debuggable, user-understandable CLI/runtime product outside Norven's machine.
scope: pre-release architecture review only; no npm publish, registry mutation, token operation, or public package visibility change is allowed by this policy

required_dimensions.question: Will the package avoid leaking local secrets, host-private entries, identity, runtime evidence, local paths and private knowledge?
Can RedCap run as npm package runtime + managed project workspace + user home config, instead of depending on Norven's skill-root working directory?
Does the CLI provide stable commands, useful help, debug/doctor/trace surfaces and human-readable failure guidance?
Does RedCap assume npm package source is visible, and avoid treating obfuscation as a security boundary?
Are public shared knowledge, private RedCap knowledge, identity and local runtime state separated so redcap-arsenal placeholders are not misrepresented as real migrated knowledge?
Is the contract clear for Agent hosts/containers: invoke CLI at revival/task/check/closeout nodes while regular development remains natural-language and tool driven?
Is the package license, package identity, registry boundary and distribution posture explicit enough for public npm release?

required_release_blockers_when_observed.condition: package.json remains private or does not use the user-approved public package name before publish
execution layer split is still dry-run-only and no runtime root exists
CLI lacks doctor/debug/trace surfaces for publish-grade supportability
CLI defaults task/status/diagnose operations to package-root state instead of the managed project workspace
package.json license remains UNLICENSED or otherwise unsuitable for the intended public package distribution

required_should_fix_when_observed.condition: npm pack candidate surface is broad internal-runtime bundle rather than curated public CLI surface
redcap-arsenal contains only templates/placeholders and no substantive append-only knowledge entries

manual_release_boundary: This policy may declare product architecture blockers, but it must not execute public release.
A later P4-2 release task must still confirm registry, package name, credentials, versioning, changelog and rollback/deprecate plan.
Any claim that RedCap is public-release-ready must cite both this review and release readiness evidence.
